title: Zero-FOUC Architecture & Instant Theme/Font Hydration Pipeline
spec:
ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA):
1. Deferred Script Timing: src/bootstrap.js is imported in src/main.jsx, which runs via <script type='module' src='/src/main.jsx'>. HTML spec mandates that module scripts are deferred. The browser renders index.html with default white #ffffff canvas BEFORE main.jsx and bootstrap.js execute.
2. Missing Critical In-Head Theme Rules: index.html has no CSS in <head> declaring background colors.
3. Competing Hardcoded White in src/index.css: src/index.css sets :root { background-color: #ffffff; color-scheme: light; } which creates flash and color churn.
4. Unstyled Skip Link: <a class='skip-link'> in index.html has no in-head styling, flashing briefly at top of page before index.css loads.
5. Un-Themed Off-Center Spinner: When authLoading/maintenance.loading is true, Spinner renders with no viewport centering and no Cuba canvas background.

IMPLEMENTATION INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Create public/theme-init.js:
   Synchronously read localStorage ('cuba_theme' || 'theme') and window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'). Set document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme) and toggle .dark class.
2. Update index.html:
   - Add <script src='/theme-init.js'></script> in <head> (synchronous, non-module). Satisfies CSP script-src 'self' and security-static regex test (has src=).
   - Add critical <style> in <head> with @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) and html[data-theme='dark'] / html[data-theme='light'] setting background-color (#0d0f16 dark, #f4f5f9 light), color, and .skip-link { position: absolute; top: -100px; }.
3. Update src/index.css:
   Replace hardcoded #ffffff on :root with var(--cuba-canvas) and color-scheme: light dark.
4. Update src/components/Spinner/spinner.scss & Spinner.jsx:
   Ensure .loading has min-h-screen, flex centering, and background-color: var(--cuba-canvas).
5. Verify:
   npm run test:security:static (44/44)
   npm run test:design-system (147/147)
   npm run test:templates (72/72)
   npm run build
